## New

- **Local lorebooks!** Make your own, or import Janitor and SillyTavern lorebook JSON. Switch them on in a chat or attach them to a persona. Built by [SirMeowingtons5](https://github.com/SirMeowingtons5), thank you!
- **Liquid glass!** With Depth on Lifted, Butler's bars, cards, chips and menus are glass, and a bot's picture shows through its own card. You can switch back in Settings › Look › Depth.
- **Chats as cards!** The Chats tab shows who you talk to as cards, with a "Jump back in" card for the chat you were last in. The old list is one tap away, at the top of the tab.
- **Chat names and personas!** Every chat shows its own name and who you played as. Rename a chat from its ⋯.
- **Continue last chat!** A bot's page takes you straight back into your latest chat with it.
- **Swipe the last reply!** Left for the next one or a new one, right to go back.
- **A message box that opens with the keyboard**, slim until you write in it.
- **Report a bot** from its page, pick a persona's group while you make it, and make a new persona or character from the round + on Profile.
- **Menus that don't hold the screen!** Touch anywhere else and the menu closes while your touch still does its job.
- **On Windows:** a side panel in chats, settings in their own window, and a switch and a colour for the glow while a reply is written (Settings › Chat › Reply glow).

## Fixed

- **/learn works on phones now!** It never did. Sorry about that.
- **The folder list scrolls**, and New folder stays in reach.
- **Tall pictures in a chat** no longer cover the text around them.
- **A bot's name on the Chats tab** is the same everywhere now.
- **Many more bug fixes!**

## Thanks

Butler's new look took a lot of inspiration from [SimpleTavern](https://github.com/Pya67/SimpleTavern) by @Pya67. Thank you!

## Install

Grab **Butler-0.5.3.apk** for your phone: it installs over any earlier version and keeps your chats and settings. **Butler-0.5.3.msi** is for Windows 10 and 11, and installs just for you, no admin needed.
